title: CSP unsafe-inline in script-src and style-src
description: Content-Security-Policy includes 'unsafe-inline' for both script-src and style-src directives, allowing inline script/style execution.
risks: Weakens XSS mitigation — if XSS is found, CSP won't block inline payload execution.
attack_vectors: Any successful XSS injection can execute inline JavaScript without CSP blocking it. Combine with reflected/stored input vectors.
poc: Review CSP header: curl -s -I https://cyberian-defenses.com/blog/ | grep Content-Security-Policy
remediation: Remove 'unsafe-inline' from script-src/style-src; use nonces or hashes for inline scripts/styles.

title: Developer email address exposed in page metadata
description: Email ahmed.chiboub@cyberian-defenses.com found in HTML meta author tag and whatweb output. Useful for phishing or credential attacks.
risks: Enables targeted phishing, credential stuffing, or social engineering against a known staff member.
attack_vectors: Use email for spear-phishing campaigns, password spraying against SSH (port 22), or OSINT enrichment on Ahmed Chiboub.
proof_of_existence: Email[ahmed.chiboub@cyberian-defenses.com], Meta-Author[Ahmed Chiboub] — found in whatweb output and HTML meta tags.
remediation: Remove personal email from page metadata; use generic contact@ or team@ addresses.

title: Sensitive file probes incomplete due to shell quoting errors
description: Multiple curl commands for .env, .git/HEAD, server-status, .htaccess, phpinfo, swagger-ui, wp-login failed with 'Unterminated quoted string' shell errors.
risks: Unknown — sensitive files were not tested. .git/HEAD on HTTP returned 301 to HTTPS but HTTPS test failed.
attack_vectors: Re-test with proper quoting: curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://cyberian-defenses.com/.env ; test .git/, .htaccess, server-status, phpinfo.php, swagger-ui.html
proof_of_existence: Multiple commands returned: /bin/sh: 1: Syntax error: Unterminated quoted string — .env, .git/HEAD (HTTPS), server-status, server-info, .htaccess, swagger-ui, api-docs, openapi.json, actuator/health, phpinfo.php, wp-login.php, wp-admin, wp-content, ghost/, admin/ all untested on HTTPS.
remediation: Re-run all sensitive file probes with corrected shell quoting to eliminate false negatives.

title: Directory enumeration not performed — ffuf not installed
description: ffuf tool was not found on the system. Directory brute-force could not be performed. Hidden directories/files may exist undetected.
risks: Hidden admin panels, backup files, API endpoints, or configuration files may be accessible but undetected.
attack_vectors: Install ffuf or use alternative (gobuster, dirb, wfuzz) to enumerate directories with common.txt and raft-medium wordlists.
poc: apt install ffuf || pip install dirsearch; then: ffuf -u https://cyberian-defenses.com/FUZZ -w common.txt -mc 200,204,301,302,401,403
proof_of_existence: ffuf: not found — all 4 ffuf commands returned exit code 127. No directory enumeration was performed.
remediation: Install ffuf/gobuster and re-run directory enumeration with multiple wordlists.

title: Nuclei vulnerability scan failed — template path missing
description: Nuclei v3.11.0 is installed but template directory /usr/share/nuclei-templates/http does not exist. No vulnerability templates were executed.
risks: Known CVEs and misconfigurations detectable by nuclei templates were not scanned.
attack_vectors: Run: nuclei -u https://cyberian-defenses.com -rl 150 (without explicit -t path, or use nuclei -update-templates first)
proof_of_existence: ERR: Could not find template '/usr/share/nuclei-templates/http': no such file or directory. nuclei v3.11.0 is outdated.
remediation: Run nuclei -update-templates, then re-execute nuclei without explicit -t flag.

title: Blog blog post references Ghost CMS CVE-2026-26980
description: Sitemap reveals blog post at /blog/ghost-cms-cve-2026-26980-ai-discovery-clickfix.html. Blog appears to be static HTML, not Ghost CMS. No Ghost admin panel found.
risks: Low — blog is static HTML. However, if Ghost CMS is deployed elsewhere or was previously used, residual files may remain.
attack_vectors: Check for Ghost API endpoints: /ghost/api/v3/admin/, /ghost/api/content/, or residual Ghost configuration files.
proof_of_existence: Sitemap entry: https://cyberian-defenses.com/blog/ghost-cms-cve-2026-26980-ai-discovery-clickfix.html — blog page is static HTML (no CMS markers).
remediation: Verify no Ghost CMS remnants exist; remove any unused CMS files or API endpoints.

title: Contact form data sent to third-party service formspree.io
description: CSP allows form-action to https://formspree.io. Contact form submissions are processed by external third-party service.
risks: User-submitted data (potentially PII) is sent to formspree.io — third-party data exposure risk.
attack_vectors: Intercept or compromise formspree.io account to access submitted form data including potential PII.
poc: Review CSP: form-action 'self' https://formspree.io — inspect contact.html form action attribute.
proof_of_existence: CSP header: form-action 'self' https://formspree.io; connect-src 'self' https://formspree.io
remediation: Self-host form processing; ensure formspree.io account has MFA and data retention policies.

title: Sitemap reveals site structure and potential attack surface
description: Sitemap.xml exposes 8 pages: index.html, services.html, about.html, contact.html, case-studies/index.html, 404.html, and 2 blog posts. All static HTML.
risks: Information disclosure — attacker can map full site structure without brute-forcing.
attack_vectors: Use sitemap to target specific pages for XSS testing (contact form), parameter injection, or content analysis.
proof_of_existence: Sitemap lists: index.html, services.html, about.html, contact.html, case-studies/index.html, 404.html, blog/securing-llm-deployments.html, blog/ghost-cms-cve-2026-26980-ai-discovery-clickfix.html
remediation: Consider restricting robots.txt/sitemap.xml if site structure should not be publicly indexed.
